title: AC1024 associative dimension dependency body direct DXF writer
scope: Write the exact source-backed AC1024 ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY profile already decoded by DRW_AssociativeObject. This closes only the standalone record serializer; source-bound graph routing, complete document output, readback, and consumer qualification remain open.

trace.observation: The AC1024 trace contains 17 ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY records. Each reports a 39-byte span, 69-bit framed body, owner and self handles, dependency-body/base/class versions 1/1/1, and its source name.

independentOutput.observation: The independent DXF output contains the record name, owner, AcDbAssocDependencyBody / AcDbImpAssocDimDependencyBodyBase / AcDbAssocDimDependencyBody subclass order, three version fields, and matching name values. This is field-order and transport corroboration only.

independentWriterSource.observation: The independent source emits the same three subclasses, version positions, and name position. Its group-90 helper width differs from this implementation, so it is not used as evidence for numeric group-code width.

formatRule.rule: Group codes 90 through 99 carry 32-bit integer values; the writer therefore uses the 32-bit integer API for all three version values.

implementationEvidence.result: Added a direct AC1024 writer that admits only the complete parsed 1/1/1 version profile and exact dependency-body prefix; writes the body name, owner, reactor list and subclass/version fields; remaps self, owner and reactor handles; and rejects unsupported versions, partial prefixes, invalid identities, and unparsed bodies. Record rollback restores output and source-handle binding after a late EED failure, and corrected retry succeeds.

results.focusedCTest: PASS 4/4 in 0.50 seconds. The dependency-body selector covers ASCII and Binary field projections, handle remapping, incomplete parse/version/prefix rejection, atomic failure, and corrected retry; neighboring associative writer selectors remain green.
results.readback: NOT_RUN; the direct serializer is not yet routed through the source-bound graph writer.

planImpact.completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: The source-backed AC1024 dimension dependency-body direct record encoder and its focused ASCII/Binary, remapping, refusal, rollback, and retry proof.
planImpact.remainingP4Scope: Reserve associative source identities before generated allocation; route admitted encoders through the graph planner; remap all references; close the full required descendant graph; inspect staged output independently and read it back; verify whole-operation publication and retry.

nonGoals: Do not claim associative graph output or complete DWG-to-DXF conversion from a direct record writer.
Do not infer other versions or associative subclasses from this AC1024 profile.
Do not change the strict refusal gate for incomplete required graphs.
Do not claim CAD semantic, native platform, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, ABI, or release qualification.
